    """Shift all non-background cells down by one row, clipping at the bottom."""
    if not grid:
        return []
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    background = max({v for row in grid for v in row}, key=lambda v: sum(x == v for row in grid for x in row))
    out = [[background for _ in range(w)] for _ in range(h)]
    for r in range(h - 1):
        out[r + 1] = grid[r][:]
    return out
